topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: Suppressing 19th harmonics reduces out-of-band emissions and adjacent channel interference, improving spectral efficiency. This allows for tighter channel spacing, enhancing capacity without additional bandwidth. Power allocation becomes more efficient as less power is wasted on harmonic generation, optimizing HPA utilization.
reference_context: SatCom systems face nonlinear distortions from HPAs, affecting spectral efficiency and power allocation, necessitating techniques like filter suppression and digital predistortion.
